
{{alias}}( value )
    Returns the loss function string associated with a supported SGD loss
    function value.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: any
        Loss function value.

    Returns
    -------
    out: string|null
        Loss function string.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias}}( 'hinge' )
    'hinge'
    > var v = {{alias:@stdlib/ml/base/sgd/loss-function-str2enum}}( 'hinge' );
    > out = {{alias}}( v )
    'hinge'

    See Also
    --------
